description: This Java class, CharsetDeterminer, is responsible for determining the character set from a content-type string or defaulting to UTF-8 if none is specified. It implements a singleton pattern to provide a single shared instance.

classes.name: CharsetDeterminer
classes.description: A singleton class that determines the charset based on content-type string, falling back to UTF-8.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of CharsetDeterminer.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Extracts charset from content-type string or defaults to UTF-8.
